title: USA C1/D Crew Visa from the UK | Air & Sea Crew Help
description: USA C1/D crew visa for airline and ship crew working on aircraft or vessels travelling to the USA. Documents, DS-160 and interview help.
h1: USA C1/D crew visa from the UK
intro: The C1/D visa is for crew members working on commercial aircraft or ships travelling to or through the USA. C1 covers transit and D covers crew duties; most crew receive a combined C1/D visa. We prepare your C1/D crew visa application and check every detail before it is submitted.

sections.heading: Who needs a C1/D visa?
sections.text: Pilots, cabin crew, ship's crew and other crew members working on international flights or vessels serving the USA need a C1/D visa. Your employer usually provides a letter confirming your role and the routes or vessels you work on.

sections.heading: The US visa interview
sections.text: Most US visas involve the online DS-160 form, paying the visa fee, and an interview at the US Embassy in London or the US Consulate in Belfast. Every answer on the DS-160 must be accurate and match your documents. We prepare your form and tell you what to take to the interview.

sections.heading: C1/D crew visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and help travellers and businesses across the UK. We check the rules for your passport, prepare your application and keep you updated until it's decided.

faqs.q: Do airline crew need a US visa?
faqs.a: Yes, crew working on flights or ships to the USA usually need a C1/D visa.

faqs.q: What does my employer need to provide?
faqs.a: A letter confirming your job, the airline or vessel, and your duties.

faqs.q: How long does a C1/D crew visa take?
faqs.a: Processing times vary with the authority and the time of year. Apply as early as you can, and don’t book non-refundable travel until your visa or authorisation is approved.

faqs.q: Can you help with my C1/D crew visa application?
faqs.a: Yes. We check which visa fits your trip, prepare your C1/D crew visa application and documents, and keep you updated. Contact us or call 0161 956 2003.
